Name: Jessie The Joja Clerk Portrait
Author: 7Kana
Description:
Portrait of a slightly younger Jessie, for the  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url]  mod.
I created this portrait because I really like Jessie's personality.
For this portrait, I was heavily inspired by the portrait done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/151675528]DacarTheGorilla[/url], which you can find on this page [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23758](CP) Dacar Jessie and Juliet anime style portraits[/url].

To install it, simply replace the original portrait with this one.
Enjoy!
